WOMEN WHO WERE DISHES

THE names of all dishes on the menu have a meaning and in the best restaurants the choice of ingredients and the method of preparation of particular dishes do not vary from one to another. THE psychologists tell us that there are five different kinds of shoppers. title: Earl
brief_context: Opened the older power station in 1927.
brief_extract:
PALMER, Magazine Secretary, Kidderminster

After an explanation of how electricity is generated the members were conducted round the station in groups. There are two stations, the older was opened by Earl Baldwin in 1927, the younger station commenced operations in 1950 and it was interesting to note the immense developments over the years. The modern power station is complex, since it has to fulfil its function of generating vast quantities of power with maximum efficiency.

title: Miss; MBE
brief_context: Gave explanation and conducted a discussion on advertising.
brief_extract: The advertisements cover electrical goods and services, household furnishings, food and drink, and clothing. After an explanation of the purpose of the exercise given by Miss Mary George MBE Director, the members were divided into several working groups with a leader armed with coloured pencils and a selection of advertisements. The small groups studied each advertisement in detail noting whether the advertisement was mainly informative or persuasive, marking in one colour the parts of the text which were factual and in another colour those which were ‘propagandist’.
